verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
The Lord is my shepherd, I shall not want
In green pastures He makes me lie down
He restores my soul and leads me on
For His name, for His great name

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Surely goodness, surely mercy
Right beside me all my days
And I will dwell in Your house forever
And bless Your holy name

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
You prepare a table right before me
In the presence of my enemies
Though the arrow flies
And the terror of night is at my door
I’ll trust You, Lord

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Even though I walk
Through the valley of the shadow of death
I will fear no evil
Even though I walk
Through the valley of the shadow of death
You are on my side

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
In Your presence
There is fullness of joy, joy
At Your right hand
There are pleasures forevermore, forevermore
